description: Look up a signup link record created by initiate_signup. Use when the user asks about a signup link Utilify gave them earlier. Returns the stored record (status, method, redirect URL) and any next-step note. Utilify does not enroll anyone, so this does not confirm that service is active: the user completes enrollment directly with the provider and should confirm with them. Requires a signup_id from a prior initiate_signup call; if the user has none, say no record exists. For electricity, Utilify does not enroll plans; point to https://www.powertochoose.org or the provider directly. If the user wants Utilify to handle setup, concierge enrollment is not available yet (electricity concierge enrollment is coming soon, once Utilify registers with the PUCT); point them to the waitlist at https://utilify.io/concierge.

signup_id.description: The signup ID returned by initiate_signup

name: check_signup_status
